name: Gwen
title: Lampadis
description: Boss and investigator at Lampadis Investigations, a private agency in NOA. Though Gwen dreams of making genius deductions at a glance, what truly sets her apart is her sheer determination to see every case through.
introduction:
The boss and an investigator at Lampadis Investigations, a private investigation agency in NOA.
Gwen fell in love with a detective drama she saw as a child and opened her own agency with one goal: to show off the greatest deductions imaginable.

She bases her methods on the kind of <color=#2A80D8>genius deduction</color> that sees through everything at a glance people love, but her tunnel vision often makes her miss key clues and leap to conclusions over trivial details.
She also firmly believes the whip and stun gun she carries are <color=#2A80D8>tools for uncovering the truth</color>.

What she does excel at is persistence. Once she bites, she never lets go, making her surprisingly effective at stakeouts and questioning that drag on for days.
Gwen herself has yet to realize that this is her true talent.

Gwen hates being compared to <color=#2A80D8>Detective H</color>, so she joins the Journey hoping to take on a bigger case and claim the spotlight for herself.
